entities.summary: Darren Boyko is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. Boyko is best known for a long and successful career in HIFK (Finland). He also played one-game stint in the NHL and the Elitserien. He played one game in the NHL for the Winnipeg Jets in 1989 and one game in Elitserien for Västra Frölunda HC in 1997.
